seo.overview.title: Travel price comparison: flights, hotels, ferries, cruises
seo.overview.description: Compare live prices from more than 20 sources: flights, hotels, ferries and cruises. With final price, tax status, source status and booking link.
seo.fluege.faq.0.q: Is the price shown the final price?
seo.fluege.faq.0.a: Only if the source states it. For many fares we also show the final price including hand and checked baggage; if that information is missing, it explicitly says "not available".
seo.fluege.faq.1.a: Because a source does not provide them or is currently blocked (rate limit). The source overview shows which sources are responding and which are paused.
seo.fluege.faq.2.a: Live with every search. The prices shown apply at the moment of the query; the binding price is the one at the provider.
seo.hotels.faq.0.q: Are hotel prices per night or per stay?
seo.hotels.faq.0.a: Per night and room, provided the source states it that way. The total price for the stay is calculated as nights × nightly rate and shown separately.
seo.hotels.faq.1.a: That is stated for every offer: included, not included or not evidenced. Resort/city tax differs by city and is mentioned when known.
seo.faehren.faq.0.q: Does the price apply per person or per vehicle?
seo.faehren.faq.0.a: Both are possible. We state the price basis for each offer (per person or per cabin/vehicle).
seo.faehren.faq.1.a: Many ferry companies offer this; whether a vehicle is included in the price shown is stated in the source's terms and conditions.
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.0.q: What is included in the cruise price?
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.0.a: Cabin and meals on board, usually including taxes and fees. Drinks packages, shore excursions and gratuities are usually extra – the source states this.
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.1.q: Why are some prices in USD?
seo.kreuzfahrten.faq.1.a: Because the cruise line bills in USD. We only convert using a documented exchange rate and mark it; otherwise we show the original price.
